summary: New Inception accounts receive a one-time credit of 100 million API tokens shared across Mercury 2 and Mercury Edit 2, with no payment details required. Mercury 2 supports reasoning, tool calling and structured outputs through an OpenAI-compatible API.
claim_steps: Create a new account or sign in at platform.inceptionlabs.ai.
Open API Keys and create an Inception API key.
Use the key with the OpenAI-compatible base URL https://api.inceptionlabs.ai/v1 and model mercury-2.
Monitor the shared one-time token balance; add billing details only if you want paid usage after the free credit.

social_proof.text: Every new account includes 100 million free tokens. Mercury 2 pricing after the credit is $0.25 per 1M input tokens, $0.025 cached input, and $0.75 output.

social_proof.text: Free Tier limits per minute: 1,000 API requests, 1,000,000 input tokens, and 100,000 output tokens.
